title: Localization model and Brown representation before splitting the unit
statement: Let A be an abelian category of objects in Type uA and morphisms in Type vA, Grothendieck relative to w, with a chosen w-Hom derived category D(A) and coproducts indexed by Type max(w,vA,vH). Let H : D(A)^op → AddCommGrpCat.{vH} be homological and preserve discrete limits indexed by that same universe. There exist a category B of object universe max(uA,vA,max(w,vH)+1) and Hom universe max(w,vH), functors L : B → D(A) and R : D(A) → B, an adjunction L left adjoint to R with invertible counit, and an object E of B naturally representing L.op followed by the underlying set functor of H and ULift.{w}. This assertion provides no split unit and no retract in D(A).

source.place: injectives-lemma-brown, first paragraph (using derived Gabriel-Popescu, Tag 0F5V)

proof.text: Use Gabriel-Popescu and its derived form (Stacks Tag 0F5V) to obtain the exact derived localization L with fully faithful right adjoint R and invertible counit. Use modules in universe max(w,vH), and lift objects to the stated larger object universe if necessary.

Because L is an exact left adjoint, the pullback H L is homological and sends coproducts to products. The free rank-one module compactly generates the module derived category. Apply [lem-pc-brown-cohomological-representability] with the universe transfer [lem-pc-brown-representability-universe-transfer] to obtain the natural representation. Lift underlying sets to the common universe max(w,vH). The given larger discrete-limit hypothesis includes the sums required by this construction.
